なぜNPBは12球団・2リーグ・143試合なのか / Why NPB Has 12 Teams, Two Leagues and 143 Games

Why does NPB have 12 teams, two leagues, and 143 games? 第4回では、この3つを一つの理由で説明せず、two-league split, team consolidation, current schedule design という別々の歴史として読む。The goal is to see a league format as a designed system deciding who plays whom, how often, and what counts toward the championship.
